62307.name: Resistor Drive · Attack
62307.SpecificEffects:
No ST type restriction.
When hit by a Tactical attack, DMG Taken <color=#F74848>-25%</color>. Similar effects cannot stack.
Whenever any enemy on the battlefield actively attacks with a Tactical Weapon, gains <color=#F74848>1</color> stack of <buf ID=623076>[Counter Charge]</buf> before combat; if self is the attack target, gains an additional <color=#F74848>1</color> stack. Upon reaching <color=#F74848>6</color> stacks of <buf ID=623076>[Counter Charge]</buf>, repairs <color=#F74848>15%</color> HP to all parts and restores <color=#F74848>1</color> AP after combat, then removes all stacks and cannot gain <buf ID=623076>[Counter Charge]</buf> again this turn.
When in combat, enemy DMG Dealt <color=#F74848>-10%</color>.
ST Body HP <color=#F74848>+10%</color>.
